purpose: Prevent repeated work on visual routes already shown to regress Brick Mother.

symptoms: pepper noise distributed across every surface
independent Base Color, Roughness, Height and Normal fields
surface detail without a formation event
chocolate, wax, foam or plastic appearance
rejectedRoutes.replacement: shared material events propagate coherently into all PBR channels

symptoms: ashlar, rubble, flagstone and cobble differ mainly by outline
flagstone made by flattening a generic block
no relation between lithology, processing and construction use
rejectedRoutes.replacement: separate parent rock, processing morphology and construction placement axes

symptoms: experimental page opens before the stronger V2.7.5 workbench
previous strengths become difficult to find
runtime success is mistaken for visual promotion
rejectedRoutes.replacement: V2.7.5 remains the unique default until explicit user approval

symptoms: lighting tuned separately to rescue weak materials
rejectedRoutes.replacement: fixed daylight validation stage plus a separate restrained product stage

symptoms: removing visual detail before measuring startup cost
rebuilding all specimens before the first visible sample
rejectedRoutes.replacement: measure each startup phase, show one retained specimen first, load secondary work progressively and render on demand

rollbackPolicy.action: restore the latest approved visual baseline, isolate one hypothesis and rerun same-seed comparison
